protocol_documents_audited.notes: Protocol only specifies the LLM generation model (groq/openai/gpt-oss-120b). Retrieval architecture is inherited from the project but not explicitly constrained.

Experiment manifest explicitly recording the embedding model used. This is a HISTORICAL experiment record, not a protocol authorization.

conclusion: No protocol document explicitly authorizes a specific embedding model. CURRENT_ARCHITECTURE_SNAPSHOT.md is descriptive, not normative. The only explicit model references are in historical experiment manifests (S-PubMedBert-MS-MARCO).
